verses.en: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
verses.pt: Sobreveio à terra uma fome, além da primeira, que ocorreu nos dias de Abraão. Por isso foi Isaque a Abimeleque, rei dos filisteus, em Gerar.
verses.en_web: There was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
verses.en_bbe: Then came a time of great need in the land, like that which had been before in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.

verses.en: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
verses.pt: E apareceu-lhe o Senhor e disse: Não desças ao Egito; habita na terra que eu te disser;
verses.en_web: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord came to him in a vision and said, Do not go down to Egypt; keep in the land of which I will give you knowledge:

verses.en: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
verses.pt: peregrina nesta terra, e serei contigo e te abençoarei; porque a ti, e aos que descenderem de ti, darei todas estas terras, e confirmarei o juramento que fiz a Abraão teu pai;
verses.en_web: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in this land, and I will be with you and give you my blessing; for to you and to your seed will I give all these lands, giving effect to the oath which I made to your father Abraham;

verses.en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
verses.pt: e multiplicarei a tua descendência como as estrelas do céu, e lhe darei todas estas terras; e por meio dela serão benditas todas as naçoes da terra;
verses.en_web: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring will all the nations of the earth be blessed,
verses.en_bbe: I will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and will give them all these lands, and your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth;

verses.en: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
verses.pt: porquanto Abraão obedeceu à minha voz, e guardou o meu mandado, os meus preceitos, os meus estatutos e as minhas leis.
verses.en_web: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”
verses.en_bbe: Because Abraham gave ear to my voice and kept my words, my rules, my orders, and my laws.

verses.en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
verses.pt: Assim habitou Isaque em Gerar.
verses.en_web: Isaac lived in Gerar.
verses.en_bbe: So Isaac went on living in Gerar;

verses.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
verses.pt: Então os homens do lugar perguntaram-lhe acerca de sua mulher, e ele respondeu: É minha irmã; porque temia dizer: É minha mulher; para que porventura, dizia ele, não me matassem os homens daquele lugar por amor de Rebeca; porque era ela formosa à vista.
verses.en_web: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”
verses.en_bbe: And when he was questioned by the men of the place about his wife, he said, She is my sister; fearing to say, She is my wife; for, he said, the men of the place may put me to death on account of Rebekah; because she is very beautiful.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.pt: Ora, depois que ele se demorara ali muito tempo, Abimeleque, rei dos filisteus, olhou por uma janela, e viu, e eis que Isaque estava brincando com Rebeca, sua mulher.
verses.en_web: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had been there for some time, Abimelech, king of the Philistines, looking through a window, saw Isaac playing with Rebekah his wife.

verses.en: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
verses.pt: Então chamou Abimeleque a Isaque, e disse: Eis que na verdade é tua mulher; como pois disseste: E minha irmã? Respondeu-lhe Isaque: Porque eu dizia: Para que eu porventura não morra por sua causa.
verses.en_web: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister?’” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to Isaac, It is clear that she is your wife: why then did you say, She is my sister? And Isaac said, For fear that I might be put to death because of her.

verses.en: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
verses.pt: Replicou Abimeleque: Que é isso que nos fizeste? Facilmente se teria deitado alguém deste povo com tua mulher, e tu terias trazido culpa sobre nós.
verses.en_web: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”
verses.en_bbe: Then Abimelech said, What have you done to us? one of the people might well have had connection with your wife, and the sin would have been ours.

verses.en: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
verses.pt: E Abimeleque ordenou a todo o povo, dizendo: Qualquer que tocar neste homem ou em sua mulher, certamente morrerá.
verses.en_web: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
verses.en_bbe: And Abimelech gave orders to his people that anyone touching Isaac or his wife was to be put to death.

verses.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.
verses.pt: Isaque semeou naquela terra, e no mesmo ano colheu o cêntuplo; e o Senhor o abençoou.
verses.en_web: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.
verses.en_bbe: Now Isaac, planting seed in that land, got in the same year fruit a hundred times as much, for the blessing of the Lord was on him.

verses.en: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
verses.pt: E engrandeceu-se o homem; e foi-se enriquecendo até que se tornou mui poderoso;
verses.en_web: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
verses.en_bbe: And his wealth became very great, increasing more and more;

verses.en: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
verses.pt: e tinha possessões de rebanhos e de gado, e muita gente de serviço; de modo que os filisteus o invejavam.
verses.en_web: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.
verses.en_bbe: For he had great wealth of flocks and herds and great numbers of servants; so that the Philistines were full of envy.

verses.en: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
verses.pt: Ora, todos os poços, que os servos de seu pai tinham cavado nos dias de seu pai Abraão, os filisteus entulharam e encheram de terra.
verses.en_web: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
verses.en_bbe: Now all the water-holes, which his father's servants had made in the days of Abraham, had been stopped up with earth by the Philistines.

verses.en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
verses.pt: E Abimeleque disse a Isaque: Aparta-te de nós; porque muito mais poderoso te tens feito do que nós.
verses.en_web: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”
verses.en_bbe: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go away from us, for you are stronger than we are.

verses.en: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.pt: Então Isaque partiu dali e, acampando no vale de Gerar, lá habitou.
verses.en_web: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.
verses.en_bbe: So Isaac went away from there, and put up his tents in the valley of Gerar, making his living-place there.

verses.en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.pt: E Isaque tornou a cavar os poços que se haviam cavado nos dias de Abraão seu pai, pois os filisteus os haviam entulhado depois da morte de Abraão; e deu-lhes os nomes que seu pai lhes dera.
verses.en_web: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father. For the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.en_bbe: And he made again the water-holes which had been made in the days of Abraham his father, and which had been stopped up by the Philistines; and he gave them the names which his father had given them.

verses.en: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.pt: Cavaram, pois, os servos de Isaque naquele vale, e acharam ali um poço de águas vivas.
verses.en_web: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.en_bbe: Now Isaac's servants made holes in the valley, and came to a spring of flowing water.

verses.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
verses.pt: E os pastores de Gerar contenderam com os pastores de Isaque, dizendo: Esta água é nossa. E ele chamou ao poço Eseque, porque contenderam com ele.
verses.en_web: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” He called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
verses.en_bbe: But the herdmen of Gerar had a fight with Isaac's herdmen, for they said, The spring is ours: so he gave the spring the name of Esek, because there was a fight about it.

verses.en: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.pt: Então cavaram outro poço, pelo qual também contenderam; por isso chamou-lhe Sitna.
verses.en_web: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. He called its name Sitnah.
verses.en_bbe: Then they made another water-hole, and there was a fight about that, so he gave it the name of Sitnah.

verses.en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
verses.pt: E partiu dali, e cavou ainda outro poço; por este não contenderam; pelo que chamou-lhe Reobote, dizendo: Pois agora o Senhor nos deu largueza, e havemos de crescer na terra.
verses.en_web: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. He called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he went away from there, and made another water-hole, about which there was no fighting: so he gave it the name of Rehoboth, for he said, Now the Lord has made room for us, and we will have fruit in this land.

verses.en: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.
verses.pt: Depois subiu dali a Beer-Seba.
verses.en_web: He went up from there to Beersheba.
verses.en_bbe: And from there he went on to Beer-sheba.

verses.en: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.
verses.pt: E apareceu-lhe o Senhor na mesma noite e disse: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, teu pai; não temas, porque eu sou contigo, e te abençoarei e multiplicarei a tua descendência por amor do meu servo Abraão.
verses.en_web: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”
verses.en_bbe: That night the Lord came to him in a vision, and said, I am the God of your father Abraham: have no fear for I am with you, blessing you, and your seed will be increased because of my servant Abraham.

verses.en: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.
verses.pt: Isaque, pois, edificou ali um altar e invocou o nome do Senhor; então armou ali a sua tenda, e os seus servos cavaram um poço.
verses.en_web: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.
verses.en_bbe: Then he made an altar there, and gave worship to the name of the Lord, and he put up his tents there, and there his servants made a water-hole.

verses.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
verses.pt: Então Abimeleque veio a ele de Gerar, com Aüzate, seu amigo, e Ficol, o chefe do seu exército.
verses.en_web: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.
verses.en_bbe: And Abimelech had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his friend and Phicol, the captain of his army.

verses.en: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
verses.pt: E perguntou-lhes Isaque: Por que viestes ter comigo, visto que me odiais, e me repelistes de vós?
verses.en_web: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
verses.en_bbe: And Isaac said to them, Why have you come to me, seeing that in your hate for me you sent me away from you?

verses.en: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
verses.pt: Responderam eles: Temos visto claramente que o Senhor é contigo, pelo que dissemos: Haja agora juramento entre nós, entre nós e ti; e façamos um pacto contigo,
verses.en_web: They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let us make a covenant with you,
verses.en_bbe: And they said, We saw clearly that the Lord was with you: so we said, Let there be an oath between us and you, and let us make an agreement with you;

verses.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.
verses.pt: que não nos farás mal, assim como nós não te havemos tocado, e te fizemos somente o bem, e te deixamos ir em paz. Agora tu és o bendito do Senhor.
verses.en_web: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: That you will do us no damage, even as we put no hand on you, and did you nothing but good, and sent you away in peace: and now the blessing of the Lord is on you.

verses.en: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
verses.pt: Então Isaque lhes deu um banquete, e comeram e beberam.
verses.en_web: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
verses.en_bbe: Then he made a feast for them, and they all had food and drink.

verses.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.pt: E levantaram-se de manhã cedo e juraram de parte a parte; depois Isaque os despediu, e eles se despediram dele em paz.
verses.en_web: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.en_bbe: And early in the morning they took an oath one to the other: then Isaac sent them away and they went on their way in peace.

verses.en: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
verses.pt: Nesse mesmo dia vieram os servos de Isaque e deram-lhe notícias acerca do poço que haviam cavado, dizendo-lhe: Temos achado água.
verses.en_web: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”
verses.en_bbe: And that day Isaac's servants came to him and gave him word of the water-hole which they had made, and said to him, We have come to water.

verses.en: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.
verses.pt: E ele chamou o poço Seba; por isso é o nome da cidade Beer-Seba até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: He called it Shibah. Therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave it the name of Shibah: so the name of that town is Beer-sheba to this day.

verses.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
verses.pt: Ora, quando Esaú tinha quarenta anos, tomou por mulher a Judite, filha de Beeri, o heteu e a Basemate, filha de Elom, o heteu.
verses.en_web: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
verses.en_bbe: And when Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

verses.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
verses.pt: E estas foram para Isaque e Rebeca uma amargura de espírito.
verses.en_web: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
verses.en_bbe: And Isaac and Rebekah had grief of mind because of them.
